headline: Fort Hays State's defence carries them five points clear
dek: Fort Hays State have won all four of their conference matches, the latest by a single goal at Ouachita Baptist on Saturday, and have conceded just once in conference play. Southern Nazarene, five points behind with a match in hand, are the only other side yet to lose a conference match.
displaced_by: Fort Hays State's fourth conference win, at Ouachita Baptist, opened a five-point lead; the standing dek's two-point gap and three-played figures are no longer true
